cases.sentence: Сын Абии, Аса, начал царствовать и десять лет делал ___.
cases.translation: Asa, son of Abijah, became king and did good for ten years.
cases.explain: The verb 'делал' (did/made) takes its object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он удалил жертвенники чужих богов и высоты, разбил ___.
cases.translation: He removed the altars of foreign gods and the high places, broke the idols.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb 'разбил' (broke) takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: He commanded Judah to seek the Lord their God.
cases.explain: The verb 'искать' (to seek) governs the accusative, with genitive forms used for proper nouns like Господь.

cases.translation: The land was at peace under his rule.
cases.explain: The preposition 'под' (under) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Asa built fortified cities in Judah.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Войско его состояло из трёхсот тысяч воинов из Иудеи и двухсот восьмидесяти тысяч из ___.
cases.translation: His army consisted of three hundred thousand soldiers from Judah and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin.
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: В девятый год царствования Асы напал Зарий с войском и тремястами ___.
cases.translation: In the ninth year of Asa's reign, Zerah attacked with an army and three hundred chariots.
cases.explain: After numerals 300-999, the genitive plural form is used.

cases.sentence: Аса призвал Господа и сказал: «Помоги нам против ___».
cases.translation: Asa cried out to the Lord and said: 'Help us against our enemy.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'против' (against) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Сын Абии, Аса, начал царствовать и десять лет делал добро перед Господом, Богом своим.
reading.question: How long did King Asa do good in the sight of the Lord?
reading.explain: The text states 'десять лет делал добро' — he did good for ten years.

reading.ru: Он удалил жертвенники чужих богов и высоты, разбил истуканы и срубил священные столбы.
reading.question: What religious reforms did King Asa implement?
options: He removed altars of foreign gods, broke idols, and cut down sacred pillars
He increased the number of high places
reading.correct: He removed altars of foreign gods, broke idols, and cut down sacred pillars
reading.explain: The text details his reforms: 'удалил жертвенники', 'разбил истуканы', 'срубил священные столбы' — he removed altars, broke idols, cut down pillars.

reading.ru: Он велел Иудее искать Господа, Бога отцов своих, и исполнять закон и заповедь.
reading.question: What did King Asa command Judah to do?
options: To seek the Lord God of their fathers and observe the law and commandments
reading.correct: To seek the Lord God of their fathers and observe the law and commandments
reading.explain: Asa commanded 'искать Господа' and 'исполнять закон и заповедь' — to seek the Lord and observe the law.

reading.ru: Земля была спокойна под его правлением, потому что Господь дал ему мир.
reading.question: Why was the land at peace during Asa's reign?
options: Because the Lord gave him peace
Because he had a strong military
reading.correct: Because the Lord gave him peace
reading.explain: The text says 'Земля была спокойна' because 'Господь дал ему мир' — the Lord gave him peace.

reading.ru: Аса построил укрепленные города в Иудее, потому что земля была мирна и у него не было войны в эти годы.
reading.question: Why was King Asa able to build fortified cities?
options: Because the land was at peace and he had no enemies during those years
Because he received money from foreign powers
Because he had defeated the Egyptians
reading.correct: Because the land was at peace and he had no enemies during those years
reading.explain: The text explains that 'земля была мирна и у него не было войны' — the land was peaceful and there was no war.

reading.ru: Аса призвал Господа и сказал: «Господь, только Ты можешь помочь. Помоги нам, Господь, Боже наш, потому что мы положились на Тебя и во имя Твое пришли против этого войска.»
reading.question: What did King Asa pray to the Lord when attacked by a great army?
options: He asked the Lord to help him and confessed their trust in God
He asked to make a treaty with the enemy
He asked to flee the country
reading.correct: He asked the Lord to help him and confessed their trust in God
reading.explain: Asa's prayer shows 'только Ты можешь помочь' and 'мы положились на Тебя' — only You can help and we trust in You.
